messages:
Sam (Marketing): Heads-up — planning a gated/embargoed launch Tues 2026-03-15 09:00 PT. Need final changelog snippet, docs anchor, and webinar RSVP link. Can eng confirm canary sizing and timing? :wave:
Eleni (Eng): We can do canary. Need exact embargo lift timestamp and the changelog PR. Also are we doing any quantization changes or just routing/kv-cache fixes?
Sam (Marketing): Embargo lift = 2026-03-15 09:00 PT (thread_ts). Changelog draft here: https://internal.redwood/changelog/PR-342 — please paste final one-line and 2 bullets for blog. No quantize, just kv-cache hotfix + routing tweaks.
Diego (Docs): I'll prep the docs anchor once copy is final. Proposed anchor: /docs/release-2026-03-15#gated-embargo. Will add a short "what changed" snippet and a migration note.
Rishi (Growth): Webinar RSVP link (staging) w/UTMs: https://redwood.ai/events/launch?utm_campaign=launch_0315&utm_source=email. Will swap to prod link when Diego drops final doc URL. Need CTA copy.
Eleni (Eng): Bench summary from perf team: p50 gen latency 74ms (prev 92ms), p95 310ms (prev 410ms). Token cost ~8% lower due to smarter routing. I can share CSV. Is that enough for marketing claims?
Sam (Marketing): That’s perfect — we'll say "~20% latency improvement on typical prompts, and lower per-token cost" (marketing-safe phrasing). Need approval on wording from eng.
Eleni (Eng): Agree to the wording above. Also recommend staged rollout: 10% at T+0, 50% at T+30m, 100% at T+2h. Ops needs a rollback threshold.
Maya (Ops): Ops ok with staged ramp. Rollback trigger: error rate >1% for 5m or latency spike >2x p50 baseline. Add playbook steps and contact list.
Sam (Marketing): Added rollback note to runbook. Draft changelog line for copy: "Improved routing and KV-cache fixes to reduce latency and cost for hosted inference." Blog bullets (2): "Smarter request routing reduces average token latency by ~20%" and "KV-cache hotfix improves cold-cache tail latency and reduces token compute costs."
Diego (Docs): I'll take Sam's draft and put into /docs/release-2026-03-15. Will add migration/compatibility notes. ETA EOD.
Eleni (Eng): I'll drop final approved changelog bullet into the PR by 14:00 PT and link here.
release-bot: Canary scheduled: 10% -> 1766664834 (T+1h), 50% -> 1766666634 (T+1.5h), 100% -> 1766668434 (T+2.5h). Automated health checks enabled. :robot_face:
Rishi (Growth): Once Diego publishes docs, I'll update RSVP link with final UTM and wire to Pardot. Also need 1-sentence speaker blurb for the launch webinar.
Sam (Marketing): Speaker blurb: "Join Redwood engineers to see live demos of lower-latency inference and our new routing controls." Keep it short.
Maya (Ops): Ops to monitor canary and will post metrics to #eng-sre. If anything >threshold I'll open incident and tag this thread.
Eleni (Eng): Quick ask — please include the exact model variant name in the blog/docs (we used rwd-infer-v2-small in canary).
Sam (Marketing): Noted, will include model name. Thanks everyone. Tagging @Eleni @Diego @Maya. If anything changes, post updates here. :thumbsup:
